__comment: FarmSense Brew — Grafana Dashboard: Field Staff View
__instructions: Import: Grafana → Dashboards → Import → Paste JSON
Set MySQL data source name to 'farmsense-mysql' before importing
This dashboard is designed for NON-TECHNICAL farm workers — NO raw sensor data shown
title: FarmSense Brew — Field Staff Dashboard

options.content:
📋 Field Staff Dashboard — FarmSense Brew

Simple instructions for your work today. Follow the colors and actions below.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CONCAT(COUNT(DISTINCT sr.node_id), ' zone(s) need attention — ', GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT(sn.position, ' (', sr.clr_risk, ')') SEPARATOR ', ')) AS value FROM sensor_readings sr INNER JOIN (SELECT node_id, MAX(recorded_at) AS latest FROM sensor_readings GROUP BY node_id) l ON sr.node_id = l.node_id AND sr.recorded_at = l.latest LEFT JOIN sensor_nodes sn ON sr.node_id = sn.node_id WHERE sr.clr_risk = 'HIGH' OR sr.soil_pct < 30

SELECT CASE WHEN sr.clr_risk = 'HIGH' THEN '🔴 CRITICAL — Check for disease signs NOW' WHEN sr.clr_risk = 'MODERATE' THEN '🟡 WATCH — Monitor this area closely' ELSE '🟢 GOOD — Continue regular work' END AS value FROM sensor_readings sr WHERE sr.node_id = 'NODE_01' ORDER BY sr.recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN sr.clr_risk = 'HIGH' THEN '🔴 CRITICAL — DO NOT WATER. Check leaves for rust spots.' WHEN sr.clr_risk = 'MODERATE' THEN '🟡 WATCH — Monitor this area closely' ELSE '🟢 GOOD — Continue regular work' END AS value FROM sensor_readings sr WHERE sr.node_id = 'NODE_02' ORDER BY sr.recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN sr.clr_risk = 'HIGH' THEN '🔴 CRITICAL — Check for disease signs NOW' WHEN sr.clr_risk = 'MODERATE' THEN '🟡 WATCH — Monitor this area closely' ELSE '🟢 GOOD — Continue regular work' END AS value FROM sensor_readings sr WHERE sr.node_id = 'NODE_05' ORDER BY sr.recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN sr.clr_risk = 'HIGH' THEN '🔴 CRITICAL — Check for disease signs NOW' WHEN sr.clr_risk = 'MODERATE' THEN '🟡 WATCH — Monitor this area closely' ELSE '🟢 GOOD — Continue regular work' END AS value FROM sensor_readings sr WHERE sr.node_id = 'NODE_03' ORDER BY sr.recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN sr.clr_risk = 'HIGH' THEN '🔴 CRITICAL — Check for disease signs NOW' WHEN sr.soil_pct < 30 THEN '🔵 WATERING — Drip irrigation is ON. Check for leaks.' WHEN sr.clr_risk = 'MODERATE' THEN '🟡 WATCH — Monitor this area closely' ELSE '🟢 GOOD — Continue regular work' END AS value FROM sensor_readings sr WHERE sr.node_id = 'NODE_04' ORDER BY sr.recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT sn.position AS 'Zone', CASE WHEN sr.clr_risk = 'HIGH' AND sr.soil_pct < 35 THEN '🚨 URGENT: DO NOT WATER this zone. Disease risk is HIGH. Check leaf undersides for yellow-orange spots. Report any findings to supervisor immediately.' WHEN sr.clr_risk = 'HIGH' THEN '🚨 URGENT: Disease risk HIGH. Walk through zone and look for yellow spots on leaves. Take photos of suspicious leaves. Do NOT water.' WHEN sr.soil_pct < 30 THEN '👷 ACTION: Drip irrigation is ON. Soil is very dry. Check drip lines for clogs. Monitor for 2 hours then report.' WHEN sr.soil_pct < 35 THEN '👷 ACTION: Prepare to water. If soil gets drier, irrigation will start automatically. Check weather — if rain expected, wait.' WHEN sr.clr_risk = 'MODERATE' THEN '⚠️ WATCH: Conditions may worsen. Walk through zone during next check. Look for any unusual leaf spots. Report anything unusual.' ELSE '✅ ALL GOOD: Continue regular monitoring. Check plants for pests. Remove fallen leaves from ground. Next check in 4 hours.' END AS 'What To Do', CASE WHEN sr.soil_pct < 30 THEN '💧 Very Dry' WHEN sr.soil_pct < 35 THEN '💧 Needs Water' ELSE '✓ Good' END AS 'Soil Water', CASE WHEN sr.clr_risk = 'HIGH' THEN '🦠 HIGH' WHEN sr.clr_risk = 'MODERATE' THEN '⚠️ WATCH' ELSE '✓ Safe' END AS 'Disease Risk', CASE WHEN sr.soil_pct < 35 AND sr.clr_risk != 'HIGH' THEN '💧 ON' WHEN sr.clr_risk = 'HIGH' THEN '🚫 STOP' ELSE '⏸ OFF' END AS 'Water Valve' FROM sensor_readings sr INNER JOIN (SELECT node_id, MAX(recorded_at) AS latest FROM sensor_readings GROUP BY node_id) l ON sr.node_id = l.node_id AND sr.recorded_at = l.latest LEFT JOIN sensor_nodes sn ON sr.node_id = sn.node_id ORDER BY FIELD(sr.clr_risk, 'HIGH', 'MODERATE', 'LOW'), sr.node_id

options.content:
Green = Everything is good, do regular work
Yellow = Watch carefully, action may be needed soon
Red = Do this NOW, very important
